decisions.reason: A core-adjacent air fin cooler in a growing industry meets aspirations, and the expanding firm has slack to carry it.
The air cooled condenser fits the established portfolio and early results give no shortfall signal, though it overlaps somewhat with Product C.
It is a near-duplicate of B and could be consolidated, but with growth and slack there is little pressure for problemistic search.
Tube liners strengthen the lifecycle service business, which tends to perform well and supports the firm's service strategy.
Customized air coolers match the firm's core competence in integrated solutions and are likely to meet aspiration levels.
Tube end repair inserts complement the repair and spare parts services at low cost, so slack easily covers them.
